اعتديا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَدَيَا (iʕtadayā) /iʕ.ta.da.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِعْتَدَى (iʕtadā)
# اُعْتُدِيَا (uʕtudiyā) /uʕ.tu.di.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِعْتَدَى (iʕtadā)
# اِعْتَدِيَا (iʕtadiyā) /iʕ.ta.di.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِعْتَدَى (iʕtadā)
